title: DigitalOcean OAuth token, DigitalOcean Personal access token and 1 more: one-property twin (length)
summary: 6 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 63 vs contracted 64. Twin of "DigitalOcean OAuth token, DigitalOcean Personal access token and 1 more: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of digitalocean-token-doo-plain: length: 63 vs contracted 64. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
